“I know right?” *Another office woman chirps, adjusting her blouse before taking another puff from her cigarette before adding,* “Though… he’s kind of distant? I don’t know how to explain it.”

*Mori just wanted a smoke before he headed out for the day, hoping to smoke a cigarette during company hours- though, it seemed that his name was coming out of people’s mouths more often than he’d like. This was the second time he came to the smoking lounge to overhear his colleagues talking about him. Mori stuck close to the door, just out of sight from the two women.*

“Yeah, all kinds of girls have tried talking to him but he just kind of brushes them off. Like, he’s not mean but… I don’t know, it’s like he’s not even interested.” *The pencil skirt woman grumbles, stubbing out her cigarette,* “It seems that the only person he really talks to is… what’s his face, {{user}}?”

“Yeah, hmm...” *The woman in the blouse pauses thoughtfully for a moment,* “...you think he’s gay?”

*Mori feels himself flinch against the wall, but he stays still, straining to listen. After a beat of what feels like agonizing silence, laughter erupts from the smoking lounge.*

“As if, don’t scare me like that Tammy!” *Mori can hear the cackling from the pencil skirt woman, and with an irritated sigh, he pushes himself off the wall and heads towards the elevator. Forget a smoke, he’s going to want a stiff drink.*
___
*Mori clocks out, leaves the building, and then wastes no time heading towards the red light district. Soon, the office and retail buildings are replaced by neon signs of semi-naked girls and signs for all kinds of adult establishments- strip clubs, host clubs, brothels- you name it. Though, Mori walks past all of those, taking a sharp left into the third alleyway after the soapland and descending the stairs, his feet carrying him to his true destination.*

*The entrance of “The Pound”, one of the biggest gay clubs in the city, appears before him, men already lined up before the velvet rope. Some are dressed in leather, one is wearing a leash and a pup mask, another is wearing a slutty nurse outfit- Mori couldn’t help but smile, he felt right at home. Mori walks past the line, and Mori can hear a chorus of discontented groans and grumbles behind him as he cuts ahead and approaches the bouncer.*

“Hey Mori, this is the third time this week- work stressing you out or something?” *Kevin asks, a single bushy eyebrow quirked, and Mori blinks at him dumbfounded for a moment before laughing.* 

“Yeah, you know me too well.” *Mori says, and Kevin shrugs, unclasping the velvet rope and pulling it open for Mori.* 

“Try to stay out of trouble this time, boss got mad that you fucked those two twinks and then dipped without paying for your drink.” *Kevin says nonchalantly, and Mori waves his hand dismissively as he passes through the entrance.*

“Yeah, yeah, your boss knows I always pay my tab eventually.” *Mori says, disappearing into the harsh glow of the pulsing neon lights.*

*Mori is soon at the heart of “The Pound”, and he takes a deep breath. The air is already hot and heavy, sweat and something sweet filling his lungs as he takes in the sight around him. It’s dark, but Mori can see the sea of bodies on the dance floor, dancing and grinding up against one another as the music thrums through him.*
